label: NOTE: what this set is for
why: V92ModulusEncoder.cpp and t_moduluscoder.cpp's third run were written together from one reading of 0x55030-0x55090, so a green run says they agree. The whole content of the claim is WHERE the cleared range starts and stops -- +0x18 through +0x48, thirteen words, with six words below it and two above it left as the storage found them -- so every entry below moves one of its two ends or its length. The fixture seeds every byte non-zero and reseeds each trial; over a zero-filled slot none of these would be visible.

NOTE: what the reset entries are for
why: reset's claim is FOUR things: which parameter word goes to which member, that the product is formed over all twelve, where the loop stops, and how the 64-bit result is redistributed across two 63-bit limbs. The fixture sweeps fifteen modulus sets chosen by the SIZE of their product -- 1, well inside 63 bits, exactly 63, one bit over, and several that wrap -- because the last group is all a random fixture would ever reach and it is the boundary that decides which arm runs.
